title: Pi Composite — all paintings filtered to one signal through π
chipmunk: binocular eyes + binaural ears — focal lines become audio antennae

anatomy.eyes: 2 focal points each, binocular convergence at nose pillar
anatomy.ears: positioned at terminus of focal axis — visual line extends to become auditory antenna
anatomy.L_eye_to_L_ear: left focal axis = left audio pickup angle
anatomy.R_eye_to_R_ear: right focal axis = right audio pickup angle
anatomy.wave_transition: focal line color transitions from visual blue (88,166,255) to auditory gold (210,153,34)
anatomy.whiskers: sine wave vibrissae — detect vibrations in the signal

pi_filter.method: frac(n × π) determines layer alpha and spatial offset
pi_filter.alpha_peak: at 1/π position (0.3183) on the unit circle
pi_filter.result: images near the 1/π position are BRIGHTEST — they survived the pi filter

3d_printable: the pi-composite IS a heightmap — pixel brightness = Z height. import as grayscale heightmap into any 3D slicer.

scyborg_triple_license.ORC: pi-filtering is a game mechanic — sort by irrational position, compress to signal
